title: PitPro's first tire-changing robot goes live in Canada | TechCrunch
summary: San Francisco startup PitPro Automation said Wednesday that it has installed its first automatic tire-changing system at a tire shop in Calgary, Alberta. Changing tires is “backbreaking” work, and tire shops are facing a major labor shortage, he said in an interview.
